debug.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(data), ' - ', ELT(MONTH(data),'JAN','FEV','MAR','ABR','MAI','JUN','JUL','AGO','SET','OUT','NOV','DEZ')) AS periodo, empresa, marca, procedencia, SUM(valor) AS total FROM Empresa2 WHERE  data BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2026-10-01' AND segmento = 'VEICULOS LEVES' AND categoria = 'AUTOMOVEIS' AND procedencia IN ('NACIONAL','IMPORTADO') GROUP BY CONCAT(YEAR(data), ' - ', ELT(MONTH(data),'JAN','FEV','MAR','ABR','MAI','JUN','JUL','AGO','SET','OUT','NOV','DEZ')), empresa, marca, procedencia HAVING 1=1
sqls: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(data), ' - ', ELT(MONTH(data),'JAN','FEV','MAR','ABR','MAI','JUN','JUL','AGO','SET','OUT','NOV','DEZ')) AS periodo, empresa, marca, procedencia, SUM(valor) AS total FROM Empresa2 WHERE  data BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2026-10-01' AND segmento = 'VEICULOS LEVES' AND categoria = 'AUTOMOVEIS' AND procedencia IN ('NACIONAL','IMPORTADO') GROUP BY CONCAT(YEAR(data), ' - ', ELT(MONTH(data),'JAN','FEV','MAR','ABR','MAI','JUN','JUL','AGO','SET','OUT','NOV','DEZ')), empresa, marca, procedencia HAVING 1=1
